blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyers of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa have returned to the Supreme Court, asking it to reconsider its earlier ruling and shield the senator from arrest and possible surrender to the International Criminal Court (ICC). Atty. Israelito Torreon’s law firm submitted a manifestation dated Oct. 27, seeking an urgent resolution of the motion for reconsideration it filed in June. The same manifestation also asks the high tribunal to issue a temporary restraining order against Dela Rosa’s looming arrest in connection with his crimes against humanity case before the ICC.
